items.informal_name: Gauss Norm Upper Bound for Coefficient Terms
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R)
  [ZeroHomClass F R ℝ] [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ c → ∀ (i : ℕ), v (p.coeff i) * c ^ i ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, valuation $ v $ (preserving zero and non-negative), non-negative real number $ c $, and natural number $ i $, the product $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ (where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $) satisfies $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i \leq \|p\|_{v,c} $, where $ \|p\|_{v,c} $ denotes the Gauss norm of $ p $ with respect to $ v $ and $ c $.

items.type: {R : Type u_1} → {F : Type u_2} → [inst : Semiring R] → [FunLike F R ℝ] → F → ℝ → Polynomial R → ℝ
items.informal_description: The Gauss norm of a polynomial $ p $ is defined as the supremum of $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ over all exponents $ i $ in the support of $ p $, where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $. If $ p $ is the zero polynomial (with empty support), the Gauss norm is defined to be $ 0 $. Here, $ v $ denotes a valuation and $ c $ is a real number parameter.

items.informal_name: Existence of a Coefficient Realizing the Gauss Norm
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) (c : ℝ) (p : Polynomial R)
  [ZeroHomClass F R ℝ], ∃ i, Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p = v (p.coeff i) * c ^ i
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $, there exists an index $ i $ such that the Gauss norm of $ p $ with respect to valuation $ v $ and parameter $ c $ is equal to $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $, where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R),
  0 ≤ c → ∀ [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, if $ c \geq 0 $ and $ v $ is a non-negative valuation (i.e., $ v(a) \geq 0 $ for all $ a \in R $), then the Gauss norm $ \|p\|_v^c $ satisfies $ 0 \leq \|p\|_v^c $. The Gauss norm is defined as the supremum of $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ over all coefficients $ a_i $ of $ p $, with $ \|p\|_v^c = 0 $ when $ p $ is the zero polynomial.

items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : SeminormedRing R] → Polynomial R → ℕ → ℝ
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a seminormed ring $ R $, this function returns a sequence indexed by $ \mathbb{N} $ where each term is defined as $ \|p_n\|^{1/(d - n)} $ if $ n < d $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Here, $ p_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $, $ d $ is the natural degree of $ p $, and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the seminorm on $ R $. This sequence captures the normed coefficients' growth rates relative to their distance from the polynomial's degree.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) (c : ℝ) [ZeroHomClass F R ℝ]
  (n : ℕ) (r : R), Polynomial.gaussNorm v c ((Polynomial.monomial n) r) = v r * c ^ n
items.informal_description: The Gauss norm of the monomial polynomial $ rX^n $ is equal to $ v(r) \cdot c^n $, where $ v $ is a valuation on the semiring $ R $ and $ c $ is a real number parameter.

items.informal_name: Gauss Norm of Polynomial with Adic Absolute Value ≤ 1
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R)
  {b : NNReal} (hb : 1 < b) (p : Polynomial R), Polynomial.gaussNorm (v.intAdicAbv hb) 1 p ≤ 1
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a Dedekind domain, the Gauss norm of $ p $ with respect to the adic absolute value associated to a height one prime ideal and a real base $ b > 1 $, evaluated at $ 1 $, is less than or equal to $ 1 $. That is, $ \sup_{i} |a_i|_{\mathfrak{p},b} \cdot 1^i \leq 1 $, where $ |\cdot|_{\mathfrak{p},b} $ denotes the adic absolute value.

items.name: RingSeminorm.mul_le'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] (self : RingSeminorm R) (x y : R),
  self.toFun (x * y) ≤ self.toFun x * self.toFun y

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (X : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval X) f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, MvPolynomial.coeff d f * ∏ i ∈ d.support, X i ^ d i

items.name: Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum_range'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] (f : R →+* S) {p : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ},
  p.natDegree < n → ∀ (x : S), Polynomial.eval₂ f x p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f (p.coeff i) * x ^ i

items.name: Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ},
  p.natDegree < n → ∀ (x : R), Polynomial.eval x p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, p.coeff i * x ^ i

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {f : R → ℝ} {c : ℝ},
  0 ≤ f → (∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) → ∀ (x : R), f x ≤ f 1 * seminormFromBounded' f x

items.name: seminormFromBounded_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {f : R → ℝ} {c : ℝ},
  0 ≤ f →
    (∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) →
      ∀ (x y : R), seminormFromBounded' f (x * y) ≤ seminormFromBounded' f x * seminormFromBounded' f y

items.name: MulRingSeminorm.map_mul'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : NonAssocRing R] (self : MulRingSeminorm R) (x y : R),
  self.toFun (x * y) = self.toFun x * self.toFun y

items.name: Polynomial.eval₂_homogenize_of_eq_one
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_2} [CommSemiring S] {p : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ} (hn : p.natDegree ≤ n) (f : R →+* S) (g : Fin 2 → S) (hg : g 1 = 1) : MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g (p.homogenize n) = Polynomial.eval₂ f (g 0) p
